$comment: Every family-facing string. Written alongside es.json so the two say the same thing.

home.nicknameHint: Any name you like. It stays on this phone.
home.gradeHint: You can change this later in Settings.
home.removeConfirm: Tap a name to remove them and their progress from this phone.
home.privacy: No names or emails are ever sent anywhere. Everything stays on this phone unless you choose to send progress to the teacher.

dash.goalMetLong: You practised 3 days this week. Nice.
dash.noSkills: This grade is being written. Try another one.

check.intro: {n} questions. Take your time — there is no timer.
check.notYet: Not quite yet — and that is fine
check.keepGoing: Keep practising. You are getting closer.
check.showTeacherHint: Hold this up in class. Nothing is sent.

send.title: Send to my teacher
send.body: Optional. Sends a short code with no name in it.
send.askWhy: Your teacher needs to know which class and which number you are on their list. No name is ever sent.
send.numberHint: Your teacher's list number, not your name.
send.noName: This code has no name in it — just your class code and list number.
send.noForm: Show this code to your teacher.

play.intro: How many can you get right in a row?

family.okYourWay: It is OK to do it your way
family.okYourWayBody: If you learned a different method, please show it. Children who see two methods that agree understand both better. The method here is the one being taught at school, not the only right one.
family.noContent: Guidance for this skill is being written.
family.readyWhen: Ready for the next stage when

settings.title: Settings
settings.gradeHint: Tap a number to change grade.
settings.soundHint: Off by default. Every sound also shows on screen.
settings.timerHint: Off by default. Speed never changes whether you pass.
settings.reducedMotionHint: Turns off movement across the app.
settings.classTagHint: Only needed if you send progress to a teacher.
settings.resetConfirm: Clear all progress for this person? Their profile stays.

teacher.title: Teacher view
teacher.subtitle: Everything here stays on this device.
teacher.empty: No codes yet. Paste some above.
teacher.clearConfirm: Remove every code stored on this device?
teacher.formOverrideHint: Paste the “Get pre-filled link” from your form — it carries both the address and the field id. A plain form address works too.
teacher.formOverrideNoEntry: Saved the address, but no field id yet. Paste a pre-filled link so the code fills in by itself.
teacher.formOverrideBad: That does not look like a form link.
teacher.noNames: Students appear as class code + list number. This tool never sees a name.
